modeHintOpenRegular.message: Open a regular website to toggle.

modeHintAutoSkip.message: Off by default · already a Persian/Arabic site

explainerEnable.message: RTL applies everywhere except the sites listed as off.

explainerDisable.message: RTL is off by default. Enable it per-site using the switch above.

defaultModeHint.message: How Dynamic RTL behaves on sites with no explicit entry below. Use the toolbar icon on any page to add or update an entry instantly. Sites that are already Persian or Arabic stay off by default; turn them on with the toolbar toggle if needed.

activeFontHint.message: Switch to a custom font you upload below.

fontStatusIdle.message: Custom font loaded but not active (selection set to Vazirmatn).

listEmpty.message: No sites yet. Click the Dynamic RTL icon on any page to add one.

msgInvalidDomain.message: That doesn't look like a valid domain.

msgFontTooLarge.message: Font is too large ($1 MB over the 8 MB limit).

defaultModeHintHtml.message: How Dynamic RTL behaves on sites with no explicit entry below. Use the toolbar icon on any page to add or update an entry instantly. Sites that are already Persian or Arabic stay off by default.

fontHintHtml.message: The default font is Vazirmatn, bundled with the extension. No internet needed.

uploadHintHtml.message: Variable .woff2 files are recommended. Static .woff2, .ttf and .otf files are also accepted.

listHintHtml.message: Every site you toggle from the toolbar shows up here. Subdomains inherit automatically.

welcomeSub.message: Persian and Arabic pages, automatically right-to-left with a beautiful font.

welcomeStep1.message: Pin the icon: open the extensions menu (puzzle piece) and pin Dynamic RTL to the toolbar.

welcomeStep2.message: Toggle any site: click the icon on a page to turn RTL on or off just for that site.

welcomeStep3.message: Fine-tune: open Settings for the site list, custom fonts and the keyboard shortcut.

welcomeShortcutHint.message: Tip: press Ctrl+Shift+Y (Command+Shift+Y on Mac) on any page to toggle it instantly.

whatsNewBodyHtml.message: Settings now sync across your devices. This page also gained site search, a keyboard shortcut display, and the popup gained a broken-site reporter. Enjoy!

shortcutHintChrome.message: Change it at chrome://extensions/shortcuts (paste into the address bar).

shortcutHintFirefox.message: Change it in the Add-ons Manager: gear menu > Manage Extension Shortcuts.

shortcutHintSafari.message: Change it in Safari Settings > Extensions > Keyboard Shortcuts.
